title: The hypertrophy series: the best indicator of muscle growth
summary: Hypertrophy series episode on the best indicator of muscle growth. The description says it isn't soreness, and the garbled captions point to session-to-session progression relative to baseline and intensity windows. The transcript is unusable machine-translated noise.
claims: Soreness is not the best indicator of muscle growth
Session-to-session progression measured against your baseline is the indicator to watch
